limits: The GitHub README and release URLs could not be opened because this lane has no network access. Candidates with only those references are judged from packet metadata and card limitations.

In this revision: research-evaluation/receipt.json lines 1340-1444 and 1560-1589 (plus lines 1-1343 and 1400-1794 earlier); plan.json in full; evaluate.py lines 128-217; catalyst.py lines 1-20; access-resolution.json lines 1-115; component-history.json lines 175-182. tests/test_research_evaluation.py was confirmed to exist by glob but its contents were not read. component-history.json line 267 and manifest-20260922.json line 6134 are relied on from the refuter's citation and were not re-opened.
No commands were run. Test counts, exit codes and hashes are copied from the receipts as documented results, not observed now. The private hashed artifacts were not opened.

The typesafe-ai skill was in context (<host-path>/SKILL.md). No TypeSafe inference results were supplied. All dispositions are this lane's own source review; the refuters' findings were checked against the original sources, not adopted on agreement.
The runtime model is claude-opus-5-5[1m]. The model field uses the required fixed value opus/high.
open_gaps: skfolio contributed only WalkForward index splits. Labels, the 20bp cost proxy and the leakage assertions are repository code in evaluate.py (lines 133-148, 206), so the receipt does not show any skfolio estimator, optimizer or risk-model use.

The reserved 2021Q1 selection (momentum20, net 0.001184071666615635470939591764 over 10 invested of 11 observed episodes) scored below the equalweight control (0.001622928696130345656850000132) and below momentum60/momentum120 (0.004403128517506842397527919636). The evidence shows the validation machinery works, not that the model selection had value.

The sample is three ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM) with unadjusted raw-price open-to-open labels, 11 reserved episodes and a fixed 0.002 round-trip cost proxy. There is no alpha, total-return, fill or reconciliation claim, and no LEAN or Nautilus engine execution (plan.json lines 22 and 28, receipt limitations).

The 6-row purge matches the declared 6-session label horizon (plan.json lines 15, 18, 25). Development evaluation labels may still extend past an individual 63-session fold (plan.json line 27), and the design does not ensure statistical independence (receipt line 1776).
The reserved 2021Q1 segment has now been inspected, and under plan.json line 26 any later selection use makes it development evidence.
Version drift: the receipt ran skfolio 1.2.9, while upstream is v1.3.0 (packet pin_behind_upstream true) and has not been re-accepted.

The edgartools native output (a 371-row 8-K cohort for 2020-03-02) is not linked to the point-in-time packet, which used custom stdlib acquisition. Dissemination lag and historical as-known eligibility remain open (access-resolution.json line 13).

overturn_protocol.metric: On identical frozen inputs, labels and cost proxy: pass or fail of all_training_exits_before_evaluation_cutoff and decision-before-entry-before-exit; whether training and evaluation label intervals are verified non-overlapping; and the reserved-period mean_net_cost_proxy_label of the selected candidate against the equalweight (0.001622928696130345656850000132) and cash (0.000) controls. For c11: whether edgartools-sourced rows reach the point-in-time packet and are excluded at the historical as-of.

overturn_when: Reopen c23 if 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_evaluation.py -q' fails (tests/test_research_evaluation.py), or if a native rerun of blueprints/us-equities/research-evaluation/evaluate.py no longer reproduces the frozen plan's leakage assertions. Another splitter (sktime c3, scikit-learn TimeSeriesSplit c22, Qlib c24) can only be compared through a new variant script and a new frozen plan. evaluate.py hard-codes skfolio WalkForward and requires skfolio 1.2.9 (lines 181-183), and plan.json line 15 names skfolio. That variant must keep the same inputs, labels, 6-session purge and cost proxy, pass the same assertions, and show a measured advantage: either stricter overlap handling (such as a label-interval purge and embargo that ensures non-overlapping training and evaluation labels, not just the 6-row gap) or a capability skfolio lacks. Promote c11 to winner only if a run feeds edgartools get_filings output into the point-in-time packet step ('python3 blueprints/us-equities/catalyst-provenance/catalyst.py packet --as-of ...') and a downstream factor evaluation, rather than the stdlib urllib acquisition. Demote c11 further if the native get_filings command in access-resolution.json regresses to the 403 recorded in receipt.json. Promote a forecasting candidate (such as Kronos c16) only if a chronological, cost-adjusted run on the broad-universe dataset beats the C0 control net of 5/10/20 bps per side.

The run recorded 21 frozen selections and 6605 ledger records (receipt line 1379). The focused test 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_evaluation.py -q' exited 0 with 12 passed (receipt lines 1562-1575). The label and cost proxy (evaluate.py lines 133-143, 206) and the leakage assertion (choose(), lines 146-148) are repository code. The 6-row purge equals the declared 6-session label exit horizon (plan.json lines 15, 18, 25).
